description: Single full-year California resident; one W-2 ($50,000 wages, $4,000 federal withholding, $50,000 California wages in Box 16, $1,500 California withholding in Box 17). The plain California case: federal AGI carries over unchanged (no Schedule CA adjustments for wage income), the CA standard deduction and the CA Tax Table produce the tax, the $153 personal exemption credit reduces it, and the $1,500 withholding overpays it. Money values below are integer cents.
